finding: Generate Blueprint reports copied and emits pageerror when actual browser clipboard write rejects

testEnvironment.permissionOverride: Actual browser permission setting; no application stubs, DOM replacements or network interception.
testEnvironment.context: current isolated browserContextId retrieved through Target.getTargetInfo
testEnvironment.restoration: Browser.resetPermissions followed by original QA clipboard grants; clipboard cleared; final browser cleanup clears permissions.

steps: Create an empty owned workspace environment group with no service links.
Generate Blueprint selecting only that owned group; API arrays for all services/databases/keyValues are empty.
Allow clipboard access; native Copy writes the exact preview. Move off the toast and wait for its natural dismissal.
Seed a nonsecret sentinel, temporarily deny browser clipboard-write, then click native Copy. Observe denied permission, fresh success toast, NotAllowedError pageerror and unchanged sentinel.
Restore permission. Fresh reload at 390×844, regenerate only the owned group and repeat denial. Native Download render.yaml still succeeds while copy remains denied.
Restore clipboard access and retry native Copy; it succeeds without a pageerror.
Restore browser state; verify group is unlinked, delete it, reconcile all seven inventory ID sets and revoke only this QA session.

reproCode: async(page)=>{const origin='https://dashboard.bex.co';await page.evaluate(()=>navigator.clipboard.writeText('QA_A610_UNCHANGED'));await page.context().clearPermissions();const cdp=await page.context().newCDPSession(page);const info=await cdp.send('Target.getTargetInfo');const browserContextId=info.targetInfo.browserContextId;const errors=[];const onError=e=>errors.push({name:e.name,message:e.message});page.on('pageerror',onError);let result={};try{for(const allowWithoutSanitization of [false,true])await cdp.send('Browser.setPermission',{permission:{name:'clipboard-write',allowWithoutSanitization},setting:'denied',origin,browserContextId});const permission=await page.evaluate(async()=>({write:(await navigator.permissions.query({name:'clipboard-write'})).state}));const before=await page.locator('[data-sonner-toast]').allTextContents();await page.getByRole('dialog',{name:'Generate Blueprint',exact:true}).getByRole('button',{name:'Copy',exact:true}).click();await page.waitForTimeout(500);result={at:new Date().toISOString(),permission,toastsBefore:before,toastsAfter:await page.locator('[data-sonner-toast]').allTextContents(),pageErrors:errors,dialogVisible:await page.getByRole('dialog',{name:'Generate Blueprint',exact:true}).isVisible()};}finally{page.off('pageerror',onError);await cdp.send('Browser.resetPermissions',{browserContextId});await page.context().grantPermissions(['clipboard-read','clipboard-write'],{origin});result.clipboardUnchanged=await page.evaluate(async()=>await navigator.clipboard.readText()==='QA_A610_UNCHANGED');await page.evaluate(()=>navigator.clipboard.writeText(''));await cdp.detach();}return result;}

cause.detail: The click handler discards writeText's promise and immediately calls toast.success.

existingHelper.behavior: Await write, toast success only on resolution, catch rejection and toast error.
